vectors.rationale: Bounded vocabularies never accept unregistered members.

vectors.rationale: Bounded vocabularies never accept unregistered members.

vectors.rationale: Bounded vocabularies never accept unregistered members.

vectors.rationale: Bounded vocabularies never accept unregistered members.

vectors.purpose: Reject a numeric acquisition-run identity.
vectors.rationale: Run identity is a string lexeme and is never coerced from a number.

vectors.purpose: Reject an uppercase acquisition-run identity.
vectors.rationale: The identity grammar is lowercase ASCII only.

vectors.purpose: Reject an acquisition-run identity padded with whitespace.
vectors.rationale: No trimming or normalization is performed.

vectors.purpose: Reject an acquisition-run identity above the declared maximum.
vectors.rationale: The bounded length is contractual.

vectors.purpose: Reject a zero request ordinal.
vectors.rationale: Ordinals are one-based within their acquisition run.

vectors.purpose: Reject a numeric-string request ordinal.
vectors.rationale: No string-to-integer coercion is permitted.

vectors.purpose: Reject a boolean request ordinal.
vectors.rationale: Booleans are not exact integers even though Python subclasses them.

vectors.purpose: Reject a request ordinal above the declared ceiling.
vectors.rationale: The inclusive ordinal maximum is contractual.

vectors.purpose: Reject an unexpected field on a composite request identity.
vectors.rationale: Records forbid extra fields so unreviewed data cannot enter.

vectors.purpose: Reject a composite request identity missing its ordinal.
vectors.rationale: Both identity components are required.

vectors.purpose: Reject a request identity declaring a future schema version.
vectors.rationale: Only the reviewed schema version 1 is representable.

vectors.purpose: Reject bare Python strings for typed identity components.
vectors.rationale: Python input requires already-validated typed components.

vectors.purpose: Reject a route path that is not origin-relative.
vectors.rationale: Route paths must begin with exactly one forward slash.

vectors.purpose: Reject a route path carrying a query string.
vectors.rationale: Query controls are recorded separately from the route path.

vectors.purpose: Reject a malformed percent escape in a route path.
vectors.rationale: Percent escapes require exactly two hexadecimal digits.

vectors.purpose: Reject a wildcard media subtype.
vectors.rationale: Media types are exact and never negotiated patterns.

vectors.purpose: Reject a media type carrying inline parameters.
vectors.rationale: Media parameters are separate observations.

vectors.purpose: Reject an API version with trailing whitespace.
vectors.rationale: API-version lexemes contain no whitespace.

vectors.purpose: Reject an unencoded space in a query parameter name.
vectors.rationale: Query components accept only unreserved characters or escapes.

vectors.purpose: Reject a nonempty query value with no recorded delimiter.
vectors.rationale: Delimiter presence must agree with the observed value.

vectors.purpose: Reject a string in place of the delimiter-presence flag.
vectors.rationale: Strict booleans are never parsed from text.

vectors.purpose: Reject query parameters recorded without a query delimiter.
vectors.rationale: The observed query delimiter and parameters must agree.

vectors.purpose: Reject a Python list where an exact tuple is required.
vectors.rationale: Ordered collections are tuples in Python input, never lists.

vectors.purpose: Reject a status code below the protocol range.
vectors.rationale: Status codes are exact three-digit protocol values.

vectors.purpose: Reject a comma-separated encoding list in one token.
vectors.rationale: Encoding chains are ordered separate tokens.

vectors.purpose: Reject a numeric media-parameter name.
vectors.rationale: Parameter names are exact ASCII HTTP tokens.

vectors.purpose: Reject media parameters with no observed media type.
vectors.rationale: Parameters qualify an observed media type and cannot stand alone.

vectors.purpose: Reject a naive completion timestamp.
vectors.rationale: Timestamps are asserted UTC with an explicit zero offset.

vectors.purpose: Reject a nonzero UTC offset in JSON input.
vectors.rationale: Only the asserted-UTC RFC 3339 form is accepted.

vectors.purpose: Reject an uppercase artifact digest scope.
vectors.rationale: Digest scopes are lowercase hyphenated identifiers.

vectors.purpose: Reject an uppercase SHA-256 lexeme.
vectors.rationale: Digests are exact lowercase hexadecimal text.

vectors.purpose: Reject an all-zero SHA-256 lexeme.
vectors.rationale: An all-zero digest is a placeholder, never an observation.

vectors.purpose: Reject a negative artifact byte length.
vectors.rationale: Byte counts are nonnegative exact integers.

vectors.purpose: Reject a floating-point artifact byte length.
vectors.rationale: Only exact integers are accepted for byte counts.

vectors.purpose: Reject an underscore in a durable-record format identifier.
vectors.rationale: Record formats use lowercase letters, digits, and interior hyphens.

vectors.purpose: Reject an uppercase declared canonicalization identifier.
vectors.rationale: Declared canonicalization identifiers are lowercase lexemes.

vectors.purpose: Reject a relationship identifier ending in a hyphen.
vectors.rationale: Identifiers begin and end with an alphanumeric character.

vectors.purpose: Reject a padded publication check name.
vectors.rationale: Check names are unpadded printable ASCII.

vectors.purpose: Reject an uppercase evidence scope identifier.
vectors.rationale: Scope identifiers are lowercase bounded lexemes.

vectors.purpose: Reject underscores in a disposition reason code.
vectors.rationale: Reason codes use lowercase letters, digits, and interior hyphens.

vectors.purpose: Reject an uppercase transformation operation identifier.
vectors.rationale: Operation identifiers are lowercase hyphenated lexemes.

vectors.purpose: Reject a version lexeme ending in a dot.
vectors.rationale: Version lexemes begin and end with an alphanumeric character.

vectors.purpose: Reject an empty requirement identifier.
vectors.rationale: Requirement identity must be a nonempty bounded lexeme.

vectors.purpose: Reject one more than the maximum number of query parameters.
vectors.rationale: Collection ceilings are exact and are checked before item validation.

vectors.purpose: Reject one more than the maximum number of media parameters.
vectors.rationale: The declared media-parameter ceiling is contractual.

vectors.purpose: Reject one more than the maximum content-encoding chain length.
vectors.rationale: The declared encoding-chain ceiling is contractual.

vectors.purpose: Reject one more than the maximum retained artifacts per request.
vectors.rationale: The declared per-request retention ceiling is contractual.

vectors.purpose: Reject one more than the maximum requests in an acquisition run.
vectors.rationale: The declared run-membership ceiling is contractual and untruncated.

vectors.purpose: Reject one more than the maximum transformation inputs.
vectors.rationale: The declared transformation input ceiling is contractual.

vectors.purpose: Reject one more than the maximum transformation outputs.
vectors.rationale: The declared transformation output ceiling is contractual.

vectors.purpose: Reject a transformation with no inputs.
vectors.rationale: A transformation requires at least one ordered input subject.

vectors.purpose: Reject one more than the maximum omission source records.
vectors.rationale: The declared omission-source ceiling is contractual.

vectors.purpose: Reject an omission that cites no source record.
vectors.rationale: Every omission must cite the record that declares it.

vectors.purpose: Reject one more than the maximum evidence records per requirement.
vectors.rationale: The declared per-requirement evidence ceiling is contractual.

vectors.purpose: Reject one more than the maximum requirements in one assessment.
vectors.rationale: The declared requirement ceiling is contractual and untruncated.

vectors.purpose: Reject one more than the maximum legacy_snapshots entries in an envelope.
vectors.rationale: Every envelope component ceiling is exact and untruncated.

vectors.purpose: Reject one more than the maximum request_memberships entries in an envelope.
vectors.rationale: Every envelope component ceiling is exact and untruncated.

vectors.purpose: Reject one more than the maximum acquisition_runs entries in an envelope.
vectors.rationale: Every envelope component ceiling is exact and untruncated.

vectors.purpose: Reject one more than the maximum transformations entries in an envelope.
vectors.rationale: Every envelope component ceiling is exact and untruncated.

vectors.purpose: Reject one more than the maximum record_relationships entries in an envelope.
vectors.rationale: Every envelope component ceiling is exact and untruncated.

vectors.purpose: Reject one more than the maximum completeness_assessments entries in an envelope.
vectors.rationale: Every envelope component ceiling is exact and untruncated.

vectors.purpose: Reject one more than the maximum publications entries in an envelope.
vectors.rationale: Every envelope component ceiling is exact and untruncated.

vectors.purpose: Reject a request reference that names a different request.
vectors.rationale: Every membership component must match the membership request identity.

vectors.purpose: Reject a response observation that names a different request.
vectors.rationale: Observation linkage is exact, never inferred by position.

vectors.purpose: Reject a repeated exact-artifact identity inside one membership.
vectors.rationale: Retained artifact identities are unique within a membership.

vectors.purpose: Reject a retained artifact that names a different request.
vectors.rationale: Retention records are bound to exactly one request identity.

vectors.purpose: Reject a membership whose request identity belongs to another run.
vectors.rationale: Run membership is exact, never reassigned.

vectors.purpose: Reject membership ordinals that do not equal their tuple positions.
vectors.rationale: Ordinals and positions are the same contractual sequence.

vectors.purpose: Reject a declared request count that disagrees with the membership.
vectors.rationale: Declared counts must equal the exact ordered membership length.

vectors.purpose: Reject a run sealed before it started.
vectors.rationale: Run chronology is contractual.

vectors.purpose: Reject a request start time outside the declared run window.
vectors.rationale: Present references must fall inside the sealed run window.

vectors.purpose: Reject a subject carrying both an artifact and a record reference.
vectors.rationale: A subject is exactly one artifact or exactly one durable record.

vectors.purpose: Reject a durable-record subject with no record reference.
vectors.rationale: The declared subject kind must be represented.

vectors.purpose: Reject an unregistered transformation subject kind.
vectors.rationale: Subject kinds are a closed reviewed vocabulary.

vectors.purpose: Reject a transformation whose inputs and outputs are identical.
vectors.rationale: A derivation edge must change something.

vectors.purpose: Reject repeated input subjects in one transformation.
vectors.rationale: Ordered inputs must remain distinct.

vectors.purpose: Reject a durable-record reference with a malformed digest.
vectors.rationale: Content addressing requires an exact digest lexeme.

vectors.purpose: Reject a storage path on a durable-record reference.
vectors.rationale: References are path-free and content-addressed only.

vectors.purpose: Reject a correction whose target and correction records are equal.
vectors.rationale: A correction must reference two distinct durable records.

vectors.purpose: Reject a correction record declaring the supersession kind.
vectors.rationale: Correction and supersession are separate typed relationships.

vectors.purpose: Reject a supersession whose endpoints are the same record.
vectors.rationale: Supersession must preserve two distinct durable records.

vectors.purpose: Reject an unregistered typed relationship kind.
vectors.rationale: The relationship union is closed and explicitly discriminated.

vectors.purpose: Reject a relationship with no discriminator at all.
vectors.rationale: The union never guesses a relationship kind.

vectors.purpose: Reject a satisfied requirement that also declares an omission.
vectors.rationale: Satisfied outcomes carry evidence records and no omission.

vectors.purpose: Reject an omission outcome that also carries evidence records.
vectors.rationale: Omission outcomes carry an omission and no evidence records.

vectors.purpose: Reject a not-applicable outcome carrying evidence records.
vectors.rationale: Not applicable carries neither evidence records nor an omission.

vectors.purpose: Reject an omission whose outcome differs from its result outcome.
vectors.rationale: The structured omission and its result must agree exactly.

vectors.purpose: Reject an omission naming a different requirement.
vectors.rationale: Omission linkage is exact.

vectors.purpose: Reject an omission declaring a satisfied outcome.
vectors.rationale: Only the five non-satisfied, non-applicable outcomes are omissions.

vectors.purpose: Reject repeated requirement identifiers within one scope.
vectors.rationale: Each requirement appears exactly once in a declared scope.

vectors.purpose: Reject a satisfied status over a scope containing declared omissions.
vectors.rationale: Complete with declared omissions is never universal completeness.

vectors.purpose: Reject a partial status where an unknown outcome is present.
vectors.rationale: Unknown dominates partial in the derived status.

vectors.purpose: Reject a pull request belonging to another repository.
vectors.rationale: Publication provenance binds one repository identity exactly.

vectors.purpose: Reject an issue identity in the pull-request publication slot.
vectors.rationale: Protected publication provenance requires a pull request.

vectors.purpose: Reject a push event in the pull-request check slot.
vectors.rationale: Pull-request CI and natural-main CI are separate observations.

vectors.purpose: Reject a natural-main check whose head is not the published revision.
vectors.rationale: Natural-main CI must observe the exact published revision.

vectors.purpose: Reject an identical reviewed and published revision.
vectors.rationale: A squash merge always produces a distinct published revision.

vectors.purpose: Reject a published tree that differs from the reviewed tree.
vectors.rationale: Reviewed and published trees must be exactly equal.

vectors.purpose: Reject reusing one CI run identity for both checks.
vectors.rationale: Pull-request and natural-main runs are distinct provider objects.

vectors.purpose: Reject reusing one CI job identity for both checks.
vectors.rationale: Pull-request and natural-main jobs are distinct provider objects.

vectors.purpose: Reject a non-successful publication check.
vectors.rationale: Only successful observed checks are representable.

vectors.purpose: Reject a zero CI attempt number.
vectors.rationale: Attempts are one-based exact integers.

vectors.purpose: Reject an envelope with no represented record at all.
vectors.rationale: An envelope must carry at least one record.

vectors.purpose: Reject an envelope whose every component is known-empty.
vectors.rationale: Known-empty inventories still carry no record.

vectors.purpose: Reject a repeated legacy snapshot value.
vectors.rationale: Legacy snapshots are unique inside one envelope.

vectors.purpose: Reject a repeated standalone request identity.
vectors.rationale: Standalone memberships use unique request identities.

vectors.purpose: Reject a repeated acquisition-run identity.
vectors.rationale: Acquisition runs use unique run identities.

vectors.purpose: Reject a repeated transformation identity.
vectors.rationale: Transformations use unique transformation identities.

vectors.purpose: Reject two corrections sharing one relationship identifier.
vectors.rationale: Typed relationship identity must be unique within its kind.

vectors.purpose: Reject a repeated completeness assessment identity.
vectors.rationale: Assessments use unique assessment identities.

vectors.purpose: Reject a repeated publication identity.
vectors.rationale: Publications use unique publication identities.

vectors.purpose: Reject one request represented both standalone and inside a run.
vectors.rationale: A request identity has exactly one representation in an envelope.

vectors.purpose: Reject a mapping result claiming a different adapter identity.
vectors.rationale: Only the reviewed versioned adapter may produce mapping results.

vectors.purpose: Reject a mapping result claiming a different adapter version.
vectors.rationale: Adapter versioning is explicit and checked.

vectors.purpose: Reject a legacy wrapping that is not losslessly mappable.
vectors.rationale: Wrapping a validated legacy snapshot is always lossless.

vectors.purpose: Reject a legacy wrapping whose envelope carries a modern component.
vectors.rationale: Wrapping never fabricates or absorbs modern evidence.

vectors.purpose: Reject a lossless legacy wrapping carrying refusal reasons.
vectors.rationale: Lossless mapping has no compatibility reasons.

vectors.purpose: Reject a lossless projection from an envelope with modern evidence.
vectors.rationale: Modern components always block a lossless legacy projection.

vectors.purpose: Reject a lossless projection when a modern component is known-empty.
vectors.rationale: A known-empty modern inventory is still represented information.

vectors.purpose: Reject a projection that selects one of several legacy snapshots.
vectors.rationale: Multiple legacy snapshots are not representable in legacy v1.

vectors.purpose: Reject a projection that invents a legacy snapshot from modern evidence.
vectors.rationale: No legacy snapshot may ever be fabricated.

vectors.purpose: Reject an untyped Python entry in an envelope component tuple.
vectors.rationale: Envelope composition never validates raw mappings in Python input.

vectors.purpose: Reject a Python list where an envelope component tuple is required.
vectors.rationale: Envelope component inventories are exact tuples or `None`.
